attributes.residual: REGISTER_ONLY, real 24 (down from 30), insns 450/450, opcode multiset IDENTICAL, regnorm CLEAN-RENAMING with 0 STRUCTURAL and 0 unpaired. The v2 park's two headline facts are both CORRECTED. FIRST, its residual_class of REGISTER_ONLY was not honest: regnorm reported 2 STRUCTURAL words at +0x28/+0x30, ADDR16_HA/LO relocations whose target symbol differed (target lbl_8023F7E8, ours the nowhere-defined gColQueryLine). fndiff scored those as `real 0` pool-name noise, so no score-based screen could see them; fixing the symbol cleared them and also took TriLineCol from OPERAND_DIFF to regnorm-EXACT. SECOND, the copy-provenance mechanism it parked on is GONE: the register map is now a consistent bijection {f24->f23, f3->f2, f2->f0} with no INCONSISTENT entry, because the split chain makes the pool load land directly in px's callee-saved home instead of a dead volatile scratch that had to be copied twice. WHAT REMAINS is a different and precisely located mechanism: a rematerialization REGISTER CHOICE for the f64 0.0 pool entry. At +0xfc the target reloads the constant into f0, reusing the register that held the same constant at +0x98 and is dead by then; we choose a fresh f2 (f2 is provably free - it has no definition anywhere before +0xfc). Because the target's +0xfc and +0x114 loads share f0, its +0x114 reload OVERWRITES the earlier value and +0x120 can only read the fresh one; our two loads sit in different registers, so our stale-but-numerically-equal f2 survives and +0x120 reads it. That is why webfrank_audit now rejects at +0x120 with 'use of f2 does not correspond to f0 under the running renaming' instead of at the v2 park's +0x2d0: same guard limitation (value-equivalence across equal-valued defs is deliberately not modelled), new and much narrower site. Everything from +0x88 to +0xe4 is register-identical, so no earlier divergence feeds it. claim.law.repeated-fp-pool-literal-first-load-is-position-invariant governs the surviving shape and states the source levers for a rematerialized pool constant's FPR are unavailable; six distinct axes above measured consistently with that. DO NOT retry axes 1, 2, 5, 6 or 7 - each has a measured regression or a matched pair of identical results. WEBFRANK REMAINS BARRED and must not be forced with an unproven_recolor_audit escape: the honest closure is the copy/value-equivalence guard extension the v2 park already specified.
